'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****Head of the [[Investigative Committee of Russia]], [[Alexander Bastrykin]], says that Russia has [[criminal charge|charged]] 92 members of the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine]] with "crimes against the peace and security of humanity", with a further 96 people being wanted. There are also 1,300 ongoing criminal investigations. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62287502 (BBC News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**At least six people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[rehab center]] in [[Tlaquepaque]], [[Jalisco]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2022/07/25/matan-a-seis-personas-en-ataque-a-centro-de-rehabilitacion-en-oeste-de-mexico/ (Infobae)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Eurovision Song Contest 2023]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] is announced as the host of next year's [[Eurovision Song Contest 2023|Eurovision Song Contest]] in place of this year's winners, [[Ukraine in the Eurovision Song Contest 2022|Ukraine]], due to the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|ongoing war]] in [[Ukraine]]. The [[United Kingdom in the Eurovision Song Contest 2022|United Kingdom]], represented by [[Sam Ryder (singer)|Sam Ryder]], finished in second place, behind Ukraine's [[Kalush (rap group)|Kalush Orchestra]], at [[Eurovision Song Contest 2022|this year's competition]]. Ukraine will still automatically qualify for the grand final. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-62292162 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Ukraine]]
**Creditors of Ukraine's state-owned energy company [[Naftogaz]] reject its two-year debt freeze plan. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/naftogaz-bondholders-reject-debt-freeze-kyiv-rejects-payment-plea-2022-07-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Meteorological]] authorities in [[South Korea]] issue a [[heat wave]] warning for most of the country, with temperatures expected to exceed {{convert|34|°C|°F}}. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20220725002700315 (Yonhap)]
*A major incident is declared by [[Greater Manchester Police]] after the remains of four people, believed to be [[Vietnamese people|Vietnamese]] migrants, are found at a [[factory]] in [[Oldham]], which was destroyed by a fire in May. [https://www.express.co.uk/news/uk/1645652/manchester-news-oldham-body-found-latest-police-investigation-fire-and-rescue (''The Daily Express'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Europe]]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports 82 new cases of [[monkeypox]], thereby bringing the total number of cases in the country to 2,352. [https://www.rki.de/DE/Content/InfAZ/A/Affenpocken/Ausbruch-2022-Situation-Deutschland.html (RKI Deutsch)]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands]] reports 106 new confirmed cases of monkeypox. [https://www.rivm.nl/nieuws/aantal-monkeypox-besmettingen-blijft-stijgen%7Cwork=RIVM%7Cdate=25 (RIVM Netherlands)]
***The [[European Commission]] extends the [[Marketing authorisation|marketing authorization]] of [[Bavarian Nordic]]'s [[smallpox]] [[vaccine]] [[Smallpox_vaccine#Imvanex|Imvanex]] to also cover monkeypox. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/25/eu-approves-smallpox-vaccine-for-use-against-monkeypox (Al Jazeera)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***[[Mississippi]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://msdh.ms.gov/msdhsite/_static/23,24562,341.html (MSDH)]
***A "public health emergency" is declared in [[Harris County, Texas]] after the number of monkeypox cases rapidly increase in the state. [https://www.click2houston.com/news/local/2022/07/25/watch-live-judge-lina-hidalgo-mayor-sylvester-turner-hold-joint-news-conference-on-monkeypox/ (KPRC-TV)]
***It is announced that [[Texas]] will receive over 14,000 doses of the [[Smallpox vaccine#Jynneos|Jynneos]] [[vaccine]]. [https://www.click2houston.com/news/local/2022/07/25/texas-receives-shipment-of-14000-doses-of-monkeypox-vaccine/?outputType=amp (KPRC-TV)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Asia]]
***[[Japan]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2022/07/25/national/japan-monkeypox-outbreak-preparation/ (''Japan Times'')]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports 117 new confirmed cases of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/composicao/svs/resposta-a-emergencias/sala-de-situacao-de-saude/sala-de-situacao-de-monkeypox/atualizacao-dos-casos-no-brasil/card-situacao-epidemiologica-de-monkeypox-no-brasil-ndeg-7-se-30-25-07-22/view (GOV Brasil)]
**[[Guadeloupe]] reports its first case of monkeypox in a man in his 20s who travelled from [[Metropolitan France]]. [https://oicanadian.com/a-first-confirmed-case-of-monkeypox-in-guadeloupe/ (OI Canada)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
***[[South Korea]] reports its first local case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant#BA.2.75|Omicron]] [[BA.2.75|BA.2.75 Centaurus variant]] in a person from [[North Chungcheong Province]]. [https://koreajoongangdaily.joins.com/2022/07/25/national/socialAffairs/Korea-Covid19-BA275/20220725175325427.html (''Korea JoongAng Daily'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]]
***It is reported that more than 6.5 million people in [[Belarus]] have received their first dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://eng.belta.by/society/view/over-64m-belarusians-fully-vaccinated-against-covid-19-152027-2022/ (BelTA)]
*[[2020–2022 H5N8 outbreak]]
**The UK's [[National Trust]] says that an outbreak of [[Avian influenza|bird flu]] on the [[Farne Islands]] in the [[North Sea]] has killed over 3,000 wild birds. However, the actual death toll is estimated to be around ten times higher because birds may have fallen into the sea. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-tyne-62253049 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Canada–Holy See relations]]
**[[Visit by Pope Francis to Canada|2022 visit by Pope Francis to Canada]]
***Thousands of [[Indigenous peoples in Canada|Indigenous people]] gather in [[Maskwacis]], [[Alberta]], to hear an apology from [[Pope Francis]] for the past abuse and cultural suppression at [[Canadian Indian residential school system|Catholic residential schools]] across [[Canada]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pope-francis-canada-religion-edmonton-alberta-137ad23719603e9d370257f257ec0163 (AP)]
*[[Capital punishment in Myanmar]]
**[[Myanmar]] announces that it has [[capital punishment|executed]] four prisoners on charges of [[terrorism]], including [[Zayar Thaw]], a former lawmaker under ousted leader [[Aung San Suu Kyi]], and [[Kyaw Min Yu]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/25/myanmar-junta-executes-democracy-activists-state-media (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-junta-execute-four-democracy-activists-state-media-2022-07-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Central Park jogger case]]
**A sixth man in the [[Central Park]] Five case in [[Manhattan]], [[NYC]], U.S., is exonerated of the crime. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/sixth-boy-charged-central-park-jogger-case-be-exonerated-2022-07-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Langley shootings]]
**Three people, including the shooter, are killed, and two others are seriously injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Langley, British Columbia (city)|Langley, British Columbia]], Canada. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/langley-shootings-emergency-alert-1.6530983 (CBC)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Tunisian constitutional referendum]]
**[[Tunisia]]n citizens head to the polls to vote in a [[Elections in Tunisia|constitutional referendum]], which was proposed by [[President of Tunisia|President]] [[Kais Saied]] as a solution to the country's ongoing [[2021–2022 Tunisian political crisis|political crisis]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/tunisia-votes-in-referendum-on-controversial-constitution/a-62582194 (DW)]
*[[2022 Indian presidential election]]
**[[Droupadi Murmu]] is sworn in as [[President of India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/25/droupadi-murmu-takes-oath-as-indias-first-tribal-president (Al Jazeera)]
